about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover P460e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover P460e is part of the current L460 generation, introduced in 2022. It uses the AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 — a 3.0-litre petrol plug-in hybrid unit that pairs the Ingenium six-cylinder engine with a 105kW electric motor. The P460e badge tracks its power output tier, sitting alongside the P440e, P510e and P550e within the same engine family across the plug-in hybrid Range Rover range.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 engines for every Range Rover P460e on the road.
